items.title: 8.3.2 Effective Navigation and Managing Digital Information (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Online maloomat dhoondte waqt achhi tarah search karna aana zaroori hai. Apne topic se mutalliq specific keywords se shuru karein. Results ko mehdood (narrow) karne ke liye advanced search options bhi istemal kar sakte hain. Bohat si online libraries aur databases filters dete hain jin se date, author (likhne wale) ya subject ke hisab se search hoti hai. Kaam ke resources mil jayein to maloomat ko sambhalna (manage karna) bohat zaroori hai. Articles ki digital copies save aur tarteeb se rakhein, aham nukaat ke notes banayein, aur apne sources ka record rakhein ta ke baad mein hawala (reference) de sakein. Digital folders, note-taking apps ya reference managers (sources ka hisab rakhne wale software) se kaam munazzam (organized) rehta hai aur research aasan ho jati hai.
Misal: computer par ek folder banayein. Us mein mile hue articles ki PDFs save karein aur ek document rakhein jis mein aham iqtibasat (quotes) ya khayalat likhein.

items: Research ke liye topic chunein aur online library ya open-access repository (muft mawad ka online zakheera) se apne topic ke kam az kam teen academic articles dhoondein.
Articles download kar ke ek khaas (designated) folder mein save karein.
Har article ka summary likhein, aham nukaat aur kaam ke quotes note karein.
Apne nataij class ke saath share karein aur batayein ke articles kaise mile aur research ko kaise tarteeb diya.

blocks.prompt: Research ke dauran apne sources ka record kyun rakhna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq “for future reference”, yani baad mein har maloomat ka sahi hawala (reference) de sakein aur mawad dobara jaldi mil jaye. Hawala dene se doosre ka kaam apna banane (plagiarism) se bhi bachte hain (8.4.1).

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text:
Kya aap jante hain ke duniya ki, aur Pakistan ki bhi, bohat si universities hazaron academic journals aur research papers tak online muft rasai deti hain? In digital resources mein navigate karna seekh kar aap ghar baithe parhai ke liye aala maloomat dhoond sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein: digital resources ka achha istemal aur maloomat ko sambhal kar rakhne se research tez aur munazzam hoti hai, aur assignments aur projects ke nataij behtar aate hain.

items: Specific keywords, advanced options aur filters (date, author, subject) se search.
Articles save karein, notes lein, sources ka record rakhein; folders, note-taking apps, reference managers.
